messages:
From: Sandra Taylor <sandra@apogee-analytics.com>

Cc: Mike Chen <mike@apogee-analytics.com>, billing@apogee-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual prepay — PO and VAT questions

Hi Neha,

Thanks again — we're ready to move forward on the annual committed spend for our Q3 start. Finance has a couple of asks before we can approve the PO:

1) Can you provide an invoice schedule that shows the advance credits drawdown over the year (monthly or quarterly buckets)? We need a simple ledger to align to our internal AP calendar.
2) VAT: Apogee is EU-registered but our U.S. entity will pay. We need any supporting VAT treatment to confirm whether reverse-charge applies or Redwood will issue VAT invoices.

I've attached our PO draft (2025_Q3_PO_12234.pdf) and a short Excel that the team uses for VAT mapping. If you can send a templated schedule and the billing contact you want us to use, we can circulate to AP.

Regards,
Sandra Taylor
Director, Finance Operations
Apogee Analytics

P.S. Mike is copied for CFO sign-off on timing.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sandra Taylor <sandra@apogee-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — PO and VAT questions

Hi Sandra — thanks for the PO and the clear asks. Quick summary of what I attached: a proposed Advance Credit Schedule (monthly drawdown), and a short VAT note. Highlights:

- Invoice cadence: we can do a single upfront invoice for the committed amount with monthly consumption drawdown vouchers sent as zero-dollar accounting memos, or we can invoice in quarterly advance installments.
- Example schedule enclosed assumes a $240k annual commitment — billed as: $60k upfront (Q3 start) + three quarterly advance invoices of $60k each. Drawdown ledger shows monthly token-credit decrement.
- VAT: Redwood will issue invoices from our US entity (no VAT charged). For EU-represented customers that require reverse-charge documentation, we can attach a VAT supplement and our W-9 / tax residency statement. Lauren can confirm any invoice fields required for EU AP.

Attached: AdvanceCreditSchedule_20250721.csv (ledger view) and VAT-supplement.xlsx.

Next steps: please confirm whether AP prefers a single upfront invoice vs quarterly advances, and which billing entity/email to route invoices to. If you prefer a DocuSign-backed SOW to match the PO, we can send that link.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com
+1 415-555-0132

Subject: Re: Annual prepay — PO and VAT questions

Neha / Sandra —

We prefer quarterly advance invoices (matches our cash planning). Also need the invoice to include our VAT registration number and reference PO #12234. On VAT: Apogee's EU entity will apply reverse-charge; our US AP team will process the Redwood US invoice and then internal chargeback. So please include the VAT supplement as you suggested.

Please route invoices to billing@apogee-analytics.com and cc our AP lead, Julia Park (julia.park@apogee-analytics.com). Can you also add a short ledger export format (CSV) we can ingest into our accounting system?

—Mike
Mike Chen, CFO
Apogee Analytics

Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — PO and VAT questions

Thanks Mike — good clarity. Attached is a revised schedule that follows quarterly advance billing with a machine-readable ledger CSV (AdvanceCreditSchedule_20250721.csv). Highlights and asks:

- Invoice schedule (example for $240,000 committed annual):
  * Invoice 1 (Upfront): 2025-08-01 — $60,000 (Invoice #RDW-INV-2025-001)
  * Invoice 2 (Quarterly): 2025-11-01 — $60,000 (RDW-INV-2025-002)
  * Invoice 3 (Quarterly): 2026-02-01 — $60,000 (RDW-INV-2026-003)
  * Invoice 4 (Quarterly): 2026-05-01 — $60,000 (RDW-INV-2026-004)
- For drawdown tracking we will provide a monthly ledger export (CSV) that shows opening credit, monthly consumption, and closing credit. That export will be emailed to billing@apogee-analytics.com on the 2nd of each month.
- VAT handling: Redwood invoices from Redwood Inference, Inc. (US EIN on file). We will not charge VAT on the US invoice. We will attach VAT-supplement.xlsx which includes our tax residency statement. Apogee can record reverse-charge on their side.

Action items for AP: confirm PO # to appear on invoice (12234) and confirm billing email and AP contact (Julia Park). Once confirmed I will: 1) issue the first invoice (RDW-INV-2025-001) and 2) send DocuSign link for the commitment addendum to tie invoices to the PO.

Thanks,
Neha
